notes: Shared catalog + two journeys (business registration, land transfer). Both reuse agency.nida/rra/self/bank, art.national-id and svc.verify-national-id — demonstrating cross-journey reuse. Structure & rejection logic are sound; every fee/threshold/regulator-name marked CONFIRM is DRAFT and must be verified via official sources or agent interviews (brainstorm.html Q4) before production use.

artifacts.name: Legal structure decision
artifacts.description: Sole proprietorship/enterprise vs company (Ltd).

artifacts.name: Valid National ID
artifacts.description: NIDA identity; foreigners substitute a valid residence permit. SHARED across journeys.

artifacts.name: Reserved business name
artifacts.description: Approved, available business name.

artifacts.name: Certificate of Registration
artifacts.description: The RDB registration certificate. Necessary but NOT sufficient to operate.

artifacts.name: Tax Identification Number (TIN)
artifacts.description: Issued automatically with RDB registration.

artifacts.name: VAT registration
artifacts.description: Mandatory above the turnover threshold.

artifacts.name: Proof of premises
artifacts.description: Lease agreement or land title for the trading address.

artifacts.name: Trading license
artifacts.description: Annual district-level license/tax granting permission to operate.

artifacts.name: Health/hygiene certificate
artifacts.description: Sector permit for food service; other activities route to other regulators.

artifacts.name: RSSB employer registration
artifacts.description: Required once the business hires staff.

artifacts.name: EBM e-invoicing device
artifacts.description: Electronic billing machine, required for VAT-registered businesses.

artifacts.name: Existing land title (UPI)
artifacts.description: The seller's registered title / Unique Parcel Identifier.

artifacts.name: Encumbrance clearance
artifacts.description: Confirmation the parcel is free of mortgage, caveat or dispute.

artifacts.name: Mortgage release / bank consent
artifacts.description: Discharge or consent from the lender when the parcel is mortgaged.

artifacts.name: Spousal consent
artifacts.description: Consent of the seller's spouse — required under community-of-property marriage.

artifacts.name: Co-owner / family consent
artifacts.description: Consent of all co-owners or family members for co-owned or family land.

artifacts.description: Proof outstanding land lease fees and property tax are paid.

artifacts.description: Authenticated contract of sale between the parties.

services.name: Decide legal structure
services.description: Sole proprietorship/enterprise vs company (Ltd). Silently changes every later step.

rules.message: Choosing 'company' when an enterprise was intended triggers requests for articles of association and directors the applicant doesn't have; choosing 'enterprise' for a multi-partner venture forces a later re-registration.
rules.mitigation: Ask intent (one owner vs partners, raising capital?) and recommend the structure; warn before committing.

services.name: Verify National ID validity
services.description: Confirm the applicant's NIDA identity is valid and details match before any form is filled. SHARED across journeys; in land transfer it covers BOTH parties.

rules.message: National ID expired, or name spelling on the form does not match the NIDA record.
rules.mitigation: Pre-flight ID validity + name-match check; block the journey until resolved.

rules.message: Applicant is a minor or legally incapacitated and cannot transact without a guardian.
rules.mitigation: Detect age from ID; explain the constraint and the guardian route up front.

rules.message: Foreign applicant lacks the status this transaction requires (residence permit to trade; foreigners may generally hold land only on leasehold).
rules.mitigation: Branch to the correct non-citizen prerequisites for the journey.

services.name: Secure proof of premises
services.description: Citizen-supplied input: a lease agreement or land title for the trading address. Not a government service, but a prerequisite the agent must collect early — it gates two later steps.

cost.note: Rent/lease cost — outside the registration system.

rules.message: Applicant reaches the trading-license / sector-permit steps without a lease or title in hand, and stalls.
rules.mitigation: Collect premises proof at intake; flag it as a blocker for steps 6-7 before they are attempted.

rules.message: Name is identical/confusingly similar to an existing business, uses a restricted word ('Bank', 'National', 'Rwanda', 'University'...), or implies a regulated activity.
rules.mitigation: Live availability check + restricted-word flag with suggested alternatives before submit.

services.name: Business registration (RDB)
services.description: The actual RDB registration. Issues the certificate AND a TIN. Registration is free. This is what people THINK is the whole job (step 3 of 8).

rules.message: Wrong/mismatched ISIC activity code vs. the business actually described.
rules.mitigation: Plain-language activity -> suggested ISIC code (e.g. 'I sell food' -> restaurant code).

rules.message: Address hierarchy (Village -> Cell -> Sector -> District) does not resolve.
rules.mitigation: Cascading address picker validated against the administrative gazetteer.

rules.message: Company path: shareholding doesn't total 100%, missing directors, or missing articles of association.
rules.mitigation: Structure-aware completeness validator; offer standard articles template.

rules.message: Poor document quality — blurry ID scan, wrong file format.
rules.mitigation: On-device capture with auto quality/format check.

rules.message: Crosses the ~RWF 20M turnover threshold (CONFIRM) without registering for VAT or acquiring an EBM device.
rules.mitigation: Threshold reminder tied to declared/estimated turnover.

services.name: Trading license (district)
services.description: HIDDEN TAIL. The RDB certificate does not grant permission to operate; a separate annual district license/tax is required, on a different channel.

cost.note: Trading-license tax varies by activity/turnover band — CONFIRM bands.

rules.message: No proof of premises (lease agreement / land title) for the trading address.
rules.mitigation: Premises checklist surfaced before the district step, not after.

rules.message: Location not zoned for the activity (e.g. a bar too close to a school/church).
rules.mitigation: Activity + location zoning check; flag conflicts early.

rules.message: Arrears on a prior year's trading license block renewal.
rules.mitigation: Surface outstanding balances tied to the TIN.

services.name: Health/hygiene permit (restaurant)
services.description: HIDDEN TAIL — the big one agents catch. The activity determines the regulator; most people don't know this step exists until an inspector arrives.

rules.message: Starts operating on the strength of the RDB certificate alone — operating illegally until inspected/fined.
rules.mitigation: Persistent 'you are NOT done — you still need a sector permit' banner until the artifact is obtained.

rules.message: Applies to the wrong regulator, or fails the premises inspection.
rules.mitigation: Activity -> correct-regulator map + inspection-readiness checklist.

rules.message: Hires staff without registering them with RSSB — liability on inspection.
rules.mitigation: Triggered when the agent records the client intends to hire.

rules.message: Bank rejects account opening because registered business details do not match ID details (loops back to identity).
rules.mitigation: Cross-check registered name vs. NIDA name before the bank visit.

services.name: Verify land title & ownership
services.description: Confirm the seller is the registered owner of the parcel (UPI) before anything else.

rules.message: The title is not in the seller's name, or parcel/UPI details don't match the register.
rules.mitigation: Look up the UPI and confirm the registered owner == the seller before any payment.

services.name: Encumbrance / dispute check
services.description: HIDDEN. Confirm the parcel carries no mortgage, caveat, or dispute. Buyers routinely skip this and discover the encumbrance after paying.

rules.message: Parcel is mortgaged, under caveat, or in dispute — transfer is blocked until cleared.
rules.mitigation: Run the encumbrance check up front; if mortgaged, route to the mortgage-release step.

services.name: Mortgage release / lender consent
services.description: HIDDEN, conditional. If the parcel is mortgaged, the lender must discharge or consent before transfer.

cost.note: Outstanding loan balance must be settled — CONFIRM bank process.

rules.message: Outstanding loan not settled / no written lender consent.
rules.mitigation: Surface the mortgage on the encumbrance check and start lender consent early.

services.name: Obtain spousal consent
services.description: HIDDEN, conditional — THE classic land-transfer rejection. Under community-of-property marriage the spouse must consent to the sale.

rules.message: Married seller (community of property) sells without the spouse's consent — the single most common land-transfer rejection.
rules.mitigation: Detect marital regime at intake; require spousal consent before the sale agreement is notarized.

services.name: Obtain co-owner / family consent
services.description: HIDDEN, conditional. Co-owned or family land requires the consent of all co-owners / relevant family members.

rules.message: One or more co-owners / family members have not consented to the sale.
rules.mitigation: Enumerate co-owners from the title; collect every consent before notarization.

services.name: Land lease-fee / property-tax clearance
services.description: HIDDEN. Outstanding land lease fees and property tax must be cleared before transfer — a frequent surprise.

rules.message: Unpaid land lease fees / property tax arrears block the transfer.
rules.mitigation: Pull outstanding balances tied to the parcel and settle before applying.

services.name: Notarize the sale agreement
services.description: Authenticate the contract of sale. Conditional consents (spousal / co-owner) must be attached when applicable.

rules.message: Sale agreement is not properly authenticated, or required consents are not attached.
rules.mitigation: Block notarization until all applicable consents (spousal/co-owner) are present.

cost.note: Transfer / registration fee — CONFIRM amount & whether a percentage applies.

rules.message: Incorrect fee paid / payment not matched to the application.
rules.mitigation: Compute the expected fee from parcel value and pre-fill the payment reference.

services.name: Apply for land transfer (RLMUA / Irembo)
services.description: The step everyone THINKS is 'the transfer'. Submits the agreement, IDs, clearances and payment; RLMUA updates the register and issues the new title.

cost.note: Application itself; fees paid in the prior step.

rules.message: Application submitted without a required attachment (consent, clearance, or payment proof).
rules.mitigation: Don't allow submission until every prerequisite artifact for this profile is present (this is exactly what the dependency engine computes).
